findings.summary: The e2e red-target test injects the single transport failure through the sealer's durable-ref push (op=push) rather than the ls-remote operation named in the spec's injection-point note; same transport closed set, same verbatim GnuTLS fixture, same retry executor, and the binding red-target assertions 1-5 are vehicle-agnostic and all mechanically asserted.

The control-plane read-side ls-remote probe and the replayer's trim-time ls-remote/push run under the default policy without an explicit fence_seconds (bounded by the 5-attempt budget); both are auxiliary paths outside stage execution, and every stage-path call site is fenced by its stage run fence, so the spec's fence clause is satisfied where it binds.
